rule: Status is based only on repository code plus automated evidence. VERIFIED requires an end-to-end or equivalent regression suite on the active candidate; production deployment is tracked separately.
truth_rule: truth_status classifies implementation truth without replacing the legacy runtime/UI status contract: EXISTANT_ET_TESTE requires repository implementation plus listed automated evidence; EXISTANT_NON_TESTE is reserved for implemented code without adequate automated evidence; PARTIEL means only a subset of the promised capability is evidenced; STUB means scaffold only; NOT_IMPLEMENTED means no usable implementation is evidenced; BLOQUE means an implementation exists but a current blocker prevents safe use.
